## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new setter breaks case-insensitive writes and should be corrected before merge. Both changed files and all available tests were read; tests were not executed.

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — `set("ALPHA", 1)` stores `"ALPHA"`, but `get("ALPHA")` and `get("alpha")` both look up `"alpha"` and return `None`. Normalize the key with `key.lower()` when writing and add a regression test for mixed-case writes. — Values written with uppercase characters cannot be retrieved.
